SPEC COMPLIANCE CHUNK FP-06: FHIRPath — §5.5.1 iif, §5.5.2 Boolean Conversion, §5.5.3 Integer Conversion. Test these items: iif(criterion, true-result, otherwise-result), toBoolean(), convertsToBoolean(), toInteger(), convertsToInteger(). For DuckDB-backed FHIRPath/CQL surfaces, test both the native/C++ extension path and the Python fallback where both exist, and compare outputs between paths. For SQL-on-FHIR ViewDefinition chunks, test parser validation, SQL generation, DuckDB execution, and official spec fixtures/examples relevant to the chunk.

When the pipeline is fully complete, set workflow to null, set exit_reason, write all handoff files, and return control to the outer spec compliance orchestrator.

issues.spec_citation: FHIRPath §5.5.1 iif (branch expression scope; native fn_iif saves/restores defined_variables_ and scopes chain_defined_vars_ per branch)

Probe: .temp/qa/fp06_historian_2026_08_17/probe.py
issues.root_cause: Missing scope save/restore in Python iif_macro
issues.resolution: iif_macro now saves/restores vars and scopes _chain_defined_vars_ around criterion and both branches, mirroring native fn_iif (evaluator.cpp:7169)
